about.title: Eight years of shaping the whole town
about.lead: StayFit was started in Novi Bečej with a simple idea: serious training and a friendly atmosphere in one place.

story.label: How it started
story.title: From a small room to a community hub
story.p1: StayFit opened in 2018, in a space of just 120 m². Today we have a modern room with free weights, a cardio zone and space for group classes — but the core idea stayed the same: training available to everyone.
story.p2: We believe training is easier when the people around you cheer you on. That's why StayFit is a community first — trainers follow every member's progress.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Do I need a long-term contract?
faq.a1: No. Membership is paid monthly; paying for 3 or 12 months at once gets you a discount listed in the price list.
faq.q2: Do you have equipment for absolute beginners?
faq.a2: Yes, every new membership includes a free introduction to the equipment.
faq.a3: Yes, we have free parking in front of the building for all members.
